DICETHESPIRE-ACCELERATE.description: At the start of each turn, [gold]Inspect[/gold] [blue]{Power}[/blue].
DICETHESPIRE-ACCELERATE.flavor: "These combats go so much faster if you only use good cards..."
DICETHESPIRE-ACCELERATE.title: Accelerate
DICETHESPIRE-AUTO_BUMP.description: At the start of each turn, [gold]Bump[/gold] {Power:plural:a card|[blue]{Power}[/blue] cards}.
DICETHESPIRE-AUTO_BUMP.flavor: "Small incremental improvement leads to large collective improvements. As long as things are getting better, they'll keep getting better..."
DICETHESPIRE-AUTO_BUMP.title: Auto Bump
DICETHESPIRE-BATTLE_WRENCH.description: At the start of each turn, draw {Power:plural:a card|[blue]{Power}[/blue] cards}.
DICETHESPIRE-BATTLE_WRENCH.flavor: "A sturdy tool for fixing things, and it doubles as a strong bludgeoning weapon!"
DICETHESPIRE-BATTLE_WRENCH.title: Battle Wrench
DICETHESPIRE-BIG_BOMB.description: At the end of turn 3, all enemies lose [blue]{Power}[/blue] HP.
DICETHESPIRE-BIG_BOMB.flavor: "I need to see if I can smuggle any gun powder back with me..."
DICETHESPIRE-BIG_BOMB.title: Big Bomb
DICETHESPIRE-BLOWTORCH.description: At the start of each turn, deal [blue]{Power}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
DICETHESPIRE-BLOWTORCH.flavor: "Realistically this could do a lot more damage, but not without hurting myself too."
DICETHESPIRE-BLOWTORCH.title: Blowtorch
DICETHESPIRE-BONK.description: At the start of each turn, deal [blue]{Power}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
DICETHESPIRE-BONK.flavor: "...the damage wouldn't be random if these screws weren't stripped, but I digress."
DICETHESPIRE-BONK.title: Bonk
DICETHESPIRE-BROKEN_GADGET.description: This gadget is all used up.
DICETHESPIRE-BROKEN_GADGET.flavor: "To Do: Figure out how to put the magic smoke back in..."
DICETHESPIRE-BROKEN_GADGET.title: Broken Gadget
DICETHESPIRE-BURROWER.description: At the start of combat, apply [gold]Weak[/gold] to all enemies [blue]{Power}[/blue] times.
DICETHESPIRE-BURROWER.title: Burrower
DICETHESPIRE-BURST_OF_KNOWLEDGE.flavor: "Wait, this book is made of paper, what if I just use it to make new cards?"
DICETHESPIRE-BURST_OF_KNOWLEDGE.title: Burst Of Knowledge
DICETHESPIRE-BYRD_NUGGETS.title: Byrd Nuggets
DICETHESPIRE-CATAPULT.description: At the start of each turn, deal [blue]{Power}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
DICETHESPIRE-CATAPULT.title: Catapult
DICETHESPIRE-CURSED_GADGET.description: At the start of each turn, [gold]Curse[/gold] yourself.
DICETHESPIRE-CURSED_GADGET.title: Cursed Gadget
DICETHESPIRE-DIAL_UP_SOUNDS.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{Power}[/blue] [gold]Buffer[/gold].
DICETHESPIRE-DIAL_UP_SOUNDS.title: Dial Up Sounds
DICETHESPIRE-DIG.description: Obtain {Power:plural:a|[blue]{Power}[/blue]} random relic when resting at rest sites.
DICETHESPIRE-DIG.title: Dig
DICETHESPIRE-EFFICIENCY.description: The first non-power {Power:plural:card|[blue]{Power}[/blue] cards} you play each turn {Power:plural:is|are} returned to your hand.
DICETHESPIRE-FURY.description: The first {Power:plural:card|[blue]{Power}[/blue] cards} you play each turn {Power:plural:is|are} played an additional time.
DICETHESPIRE-FURY.title: Fury
DICETHESPIRE-HARVEST.title: Harvest
DICETHESPIRE-HEAT_RAY.description: Whenever you play a card, all enemies take [blue]{Power}[/blue] damage.
DICETHESPIRE-HEAT_RAY.title: Heat Ray
DICETHESPIRE-HOOK.description: At the start of each turn, add {Power:plural:a card|[blue]{Power}[/blue] cards} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DICETHESPIRE-HOOK.title: Hook
DICETHESPIRE-INFINITY_MIRROR.description: At the start of each turn, increase the amount of {Energy:diceIcons(1)} you gain each turn by [blue]{Power}[/blue].
DICETHESPIRE-INFINITY_MIRROR.title: Infinity Mirror
DICETHESPIRE-LARGE_TOOLBOX.description: At the start of combat, add [blue]{Power}[/blue] Colorless cards to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DICETHESPIRE-LARGE_TOOLBOX.title: Large Toolbox
DICETHESPIRE-MAGIC_DICE.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Power:diceIcons()}.
DICETHESPIRE-MAGIC_DICE.title: Magic Dice
DICETHESPIRE-MAGIC_SPANNER.description: At the start of combat, draw [blue]{Power}[/blue] additional cards.
DICETHESPIRE-MAGIC_SPANNER.title: Magic Spanner
DICETHESPIRE-NEEDLE.description: At the start of each turn, gain [blue]{Power}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold].
DICETHESPIRE-NEEDLE.title: Needle
DICETHESPIRE-OH_NO.description: At the start of each turn, apply [blue]{Power}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to ALL enemies.
DICETHESPIRE-OH_NO.title: Oh No!
DICETHESPIRE-OVERLOAD.description: Double the damage and [gold]Block[/gold] of the first {Power:plural:card|[blue]{Power}[/blue] cards} you play each turn.
DICETHESPIRE-OVERLOAD.title: Overload
DICETHESPIRE-PERSISTENCE_OF_MEMORY.descr: Keep your current gadget an additional combat.
DICETHESPIRE-PERSISTENCE_OF_MEMORY.flavo: "The only way to read this is by data mining, so hello data minder, thanks's for caring about this mod enough to data mine it."
DICETHESPIRE-PERSISTENCE_OF_MEMORY.title: Persistence Of Memory
DICETHESPIRE-POISON_ARROW.description: At the start of each turn, apply [blue]{Power}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
DICETHESPIRE-POISON_ARROW.title: Poison Arrow
DICETHESPIRE-POWER_UP.title: Power Up
DICETHESPIRE-PROTECTION.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{Power}[/blue] [gold]Reduce[/gold].
DICETHESPIRE-PROTECTION.title: Protection
DICETHESPIRE-QUICKER_ATTACK.description: At the start of each turn, play a random attack card.
DICETHESPIRE-QUICKER_ATTACK.title: Quicker Attack
DICETHESPIRE-RECYCLOMANCY.description: Obtain a card reward from the past.
DICETHESPIRE-RECYCLOMANCY.title: Recyclomancy
DICETHESPIRE-REPLICATE.description: At the start of each turn, duplicate {Power:plural:a card|[blue]{Power}[/blue] cards}.
DICETHESPIRE-REPLICATE.title: Replicate
DICETHESPIRE-ROCKSLIDE.description: At the start of each turn, add [blue]{Power}[/blue] rocks to your hand.
DICETHESPIRE-ROCKSLIDE.title: Rockslide
DICETHESPIRE-SHARED_INTEREST.description: Obtain a card reward from each ally's deck.
DICETHESPIRE-SHARED_INTEREST.title: Shared Interest
DICETHESPIRE-SHIELD.description: At the start of each turn, gain [blue]{Power}[/blue] [gold]block[/gold].
DICETHESPIRE-SHIELD.title: Shield
DICETHESPIRE-SHORT_CIRCUIT.description: At the start of combat, apply [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to all enemies [blue]{Power}[/blue] times.
DICETHESPIRE-SHORT_CIRCUIT.title: Short Circuit
DICETHESPIRE-STARDUST.description: At the start of each turn, apply {Power:plural:a|[blue]{Power}[/blue]} random debuff to a random enemy.
DICETHESPIRE-STARDUST.title: Stardust
DICETHESPIRE-STINKY_GADGET.title: Stinky Gadget
DICETHESPIRE-WALL_OF_ICE.title: Wall of Ice
